lesson: The encyclical title was omitted. Highly open-ended naming questions require direct leak or trademark-style evidence; without it, avoid treating generic thematic Latin titles as more than a very diffuse candidate set.

Chan was covered but badly underweighted. Endorsement forecasts should emphasize the endorser's local ideological alliances and personal political network rather than assuming support for the best-known or statewide frontrunner.
The correctly top-ranked organizational prior resolved as expected. Distinguishing the national advocacy body from its activist affiliates was useful.

Pivdennyi was included but underweighted. Vessel-route questions require the precise terminal port from itinerary and tracking evidence; a nearby umbrella city such as Odesa is not an adequate substitute.

Restore Britain was covered but far too low. For a party's first election, local candidate filings and explicit debut language should outweigh the national prominence of ideologically adjacent parties.

Germany was the right secondary candidate but citizenship was overweighted. Medical-evacuation destinations depend more on available high-containment treatment capacity, routing, and prearranged agreements than on the patient's nationality.
